text:
maria: Quick help — PR open for migration guide + SDK snippet, hoping to merge in tonight's docs window. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/842
ryan: link looks broken in the preview :eyes: — got a linkcheck failure on /docs/migration/old-api
docs-preview-bot: Preview deployed at https://preview.redwood.inference/pr-842 — linkcheck error: 404 on /docs/migration/old-api
maria: ugh, the bad URL is from an example in sdk-snippet.md. @kevin, you own snippets this week? Can you take a look?
kevin: I can do a quick fix, but I'm on calls until 4pm PT. If someone else can approve afterwards, that'd help.
sam: I can review after 3:30pm PT. If kevin pushes fix before that I can approve and merge.
ryan: heads-up — CI was flaky yesterday, so for migration guides I'd prefer 2 approvals (content + SDK). I'll +1 content but need SDK approval from kevin.
kevin: pushing a tiny patch now: `git commit -am "fix link in sdk-snippet" && git push` — will also add a note in the PR describing the change.
docs-preview-bot: CI status: linkcheck failed -> retry queued (rerun requested by kevin)
maria: plan: kevin fixes, sam does review/approve, ryan gives final signoff. If sam can't make the merge window, I'll merge and ping @eng-docs rotation to cover follow-ups.
ryan: also can we add a reviewer tag to reduce slack pings later? try `/add-reviewer @docs-rotation` on the PR to surface it in rotation.
sam: +1 to adding a reviewer tag — makes it visible in the rotation board.
kevin: patch pushed and PR description updated with "snippet owner: @kevin" and a short note about the broken example.
docs-preview-bot: CI status: linkcheck passed, lint passed, build succeeded (all checks green)
sam: quick content nit: first paragraph could rephrase "legacy API" -> "previous v1 API". Pushed suggestion in the PR.
ryan: giving content approve now :thumbsup: (LGTM)
sam: approving as well :shipit:
maria: merging after approvals. Thanks y'all :heart:
ryan: can we also add this PR to the weekly reviewer backlog board so we don't rely on ad-hoc pings for the next gap?
maria: will add to the board and tag as "rotation pickup requested"
kevin: thanks — logged a short note in the docs-ownership sheet about a reviewer gap next Tuesday afternoon.
sam: good catch, I'll bring it up in the rotation sync so we can cover that slot.
maria: merged and deployed to staging. scheduling prod push in the docs release window.
docs-preview-bot: Published to production at https://docs.redwood.ai/migration/old-api (cache cleared)
ryan: closing the loop — awesome, thanks everyone.
